title: cloud-binding: name the service in its spec contract, and give controlPlaneUrl one reading of an empty option (follow-up to #29920)
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cyvF7SP65frVFAYLv7

Filing gate: ① two should-fix findings of the contract review on PR #30749 (#29920), comment 6673473934, items 1 and 2, kept out of that PR by the seat. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested grade: p3.
Dedupe: `CLOUD_BINDING_SERVICE`, `controlPlaneUrl empty` — no open card. **New.**
Reader: `domain:server` (`packages/cloud-connection`, `packages/services/service-push`), with one export in `packages/spec/src/contracts/cloud-binding-service.ts` (the spec half is the triage's call to route).

## 1 · The service name has no single source

Since PR #30749, `cloud-connection` registers the `cloud-binding` service and `service-push` reads it, each spelling `'cloud-binding'` on its own; nothing pins the two to each other. Six sibling contracts export their service name beside the interface (`EMBEDDER_SERVICE`, `KNOWLEDGE_SERVICE`, `OWNERSHIP_QUEUE_SERVICE`, `RLS_MEMBERSHIP_RESOLVER_SERVICE`, `SEED_SETTLEMENT_SERVICE`, `FILE_ATTACHMENT_SERVICE`).

Expected: `export const CLOUD_BINDING_SERVICE = 'cloud-binding'` from `cloud-binding-service.ts`, both packages read it, `api-surface/` and `export-origins/` regenerated. An added export: `Clause-②: yes (widening)` on the spec face.

## 2 · Two readers of one empty option inside cloud-connection

The contract's docblock says `controlPlaneUrl()` answers `''` only when the deployment declared no control plane. `createCloudBinding` reads the option through `resolveCloudUrl(option)`, which turns an explicit `''` into the production default, while the plugin's own routes (`cloud-connection-plugin.ts`, ~L337) read the same `''` as "cloud not configured". Unreachable under `objectstack serve` today (the plugin is composed only when `resolveCloudUrl()` is non-empty), so a hand-composed kernel is the only reach.

Expected: one reading. Either the routes derive their URL from `binding.controlPlaneUrl()`, with the binding reading `''` the way the routes do, or the docblock says what `''` answers; a pin for the empty option.

Related: #29920 (PR #30749), #30670.
